name: Mustering Hall
description:
Holds technology from the Highlands and Lowlands. Each time a Landmark from a region is chosen, costs of their powerful technologies are reduced. Musters warriors using Food and Muster Charge costs. Each type of muster is one-time use.
Generates influence to military production buildings. Each building provides a count towards Muster Hall levels to improve its mustering efficiency and adds additional Muster Charges.
Comes with 1 Muster Charge by default.
descriptionCN:
包含高地和低地的科技。每当选择某地区的地标时，该地区强力科技的成本将降低。通过消耗食物和集合冲锋招募战士，每种集合方式仅能使用一次。
为军事生产建筑生成影响力。每座建筑都计入集合厅等级，提升集合效率并增加额外集合冲锋次数。
默认拥有 1 次集合冲锋。
